notes: The text is a fragment: «فقصتها حفصة على النبي» continues an earlier report, and no chain for it is written here or supplied in the context
The only transmitter written is «قال سالم» with no transmitter before him: a single-link group (rule 10); the Prophet's «نعم الرجل» is not a link
The source claims (HKG, RWY) give a full chain back to Ibn Umar for the whole hadith; they describe the earlier part and are not read into this fragment
